characters.name: Maya
characters.look: Chinese and Irish heritage, warm light skin, softly oval face, brown almond-shaped eyes, dark chestnut shoulder-blade length hair with curtain fringe, faint freckles across nose, slightly asymmetric friendly smile
characters.outfit: sage fitted crew-neck tee, straight blue jeans, white sneakers
characters.gym: sage athletic crew-neck top and charcoal full-length leggings
characters.work: cream tee and dark green apron, hair in low ponytail
characters.personality: Warm, observant and lightly teasing; remembers everyone's order but forgets where she put her keys.
characters.voice: Conversational mid-register voice, relaxed pace, short amused pauses. No affected baby voice.
characters.beauty: Sheer peach blush, brown mascara and rose lip tint; natural freckles remain visible.
characters.brands: Lip tints, everyday cosmetics, matcha kits, reusable cups, small tote bags.
series: From tea shift to mat class
hooks: Your matcha deserves better than this clump.
This lip combo matches my drink. Accidentally.
I packed for Pilates like it was a weekend trip.
characters.appeal: Friendly eye contact and humor create approachability; beauty routines supply a reason to save and follow.
characters.risk: Can become generic if every clip is just smiling with a drink. Keep her observant barista humor.

characters.name: Nina

series: Get ready between class and shift

My gym bag has a snack pocket problem.
The ponytail is doing most of the styling today.

series: Matcha and the long way home
hooks: The walk was supposed to take ten minutes.
My matcha is coming on this side quest.
